function.description: Collect fees from your v3 or v4 liquidity position without reducing liquidity (v4: also from an NFT's account with account=/nft=, the fees land there). Receipts are asserted; caps charge gas. dry_run defaults true.
function.name: defi_trade_lp_collect

account.description: Optional — work FROM the token-bound (ERC-6551) account of an NFT this treasury OWNS, instead of from the treasury: the account's assets move, the treasury signs as the NFT's owner. A 0x account address. Only accounts of a collection the owner pinned. Needs AGENT_NFT_ENABLED. What each account kind can do: the `account` parameter of defi_trade.transfer.

chain.description: Chain to manage the Uniswap v3 position on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and asserts without broadcasting.

nft.description: Optional — the same as `account`, naming the NFT instead: '<collection>#<id>', or just '<id>' when one collection is pinned on the chain.

protocol.description: 'v3', or 'v4' to collect the fees of a Uniswap v4 position (a decrease of 0, both currencies paid to the position's owner; no approval). account=/nft= work with 'v4' only.
